description: Shows detailed information about a Claude Code session, including summary, tasks, and conversation messages.

evals.name: Full profile of one session
evals.prompt: Show me everything about session abc123 -- stats, tasks, messages, all of it.
evals.expected_output: Runs session_store.py session-detail, presents session/token/model/tool summary plus associated tasks; offers to show messages via session_transcript.py messages if wanted.

evals.name: Correctly redirects a stats-only request
evals.prompt: I just want the token cost breakdown for this session, nothing else.
evals.expected_output: Declines to produce the full profile and points the user to session-stats instead, per its own stated exclusion.

evals.name: Correctly redirects cross-session task aggregation request
evals.prompt: what tasks are pending across my sessions
evals.expected_output: Recognizes request asks for cross-session task aggregation (not detail on one session), declines to answer using single-session view, redirects to session-tasks skill. Does not synthesize multi-session answer itself or attempt multiple session-detail calls.
